description: How java.md and frontend.md reach a context: SessionStart injection vs native path-glob loading, per access mode and lifecycle step. Mechanics, not judgement: run with a small model.

react-native.ios/App/AppDelegate.swift:
import UIKit

final class AppDelegate: UIResponder {}

cases.description: Timing: is the rule in context before any file access?
steps: Without using any tool, reply with a one-line plan for adding a farewell method to the Greeter class.
Use the Read tool to read src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.

cases.description: Edit without a prior Read: does the attempt alone trigger a native load?
steps: Without reading it first, use the Edit tool on src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java to replace "Hello " with "Hi ". If the Edit tool refuses, do not retry and do not read the file; reply DONE.

Use the Write tool to create src/main/java/demo/Farewell.java containing exactly this line: package demo; final class Farewell {}
Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.

Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: cat src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
Then reply DONE.

Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: head -n 3 src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
Then reply DONE.

Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: sed -n '1,3p' src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
Then reply DONE.

Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: tail -n 2 src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
Then reply DONE.

cases.description: Boundary: a Bash read of two files, the matching one second.
steps:
Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: cat README.md src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
Then reply DONE.

cases.description: Boundary: grep on one matching file.
steps:
Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: grep -n greet src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java
Then reply DONE.

cases.description: Boundary: a single-file read piped into another command.
steps:
Run exactly this command with the Bash tool and nothing else: cat src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java | head -n 2
Then reply DONE.

cases.description: After --resume: does a copy survive, and is it injected again?
steps: Use the Read tool to read src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.
Reply DONE.

cases.description: After /compact: which copies survive, and does a later read load the rule again?
steps: Use the Read tool to read src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.
/compact
Use the Read tool to read src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java again. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.

cases.description: Does a reviewer subagent that reads a matching file get the rule, and only once?
steps: Use the Agent tool with subagent_type code-reviewer. Ask it to read src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java and to answer in one sentence whether the class is final. Then reply DONE.
Use the Read tool to read app/page.tsx. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.
Use the Read tool to read lib/format.ts. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.

cases.description: Scoping: the React rule should not reach an Angular repo.
steps: Use the Read tool to read src/app/app.component.ts. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.
Use the Read tool to read src/app/app.component.scss. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.
Use the Read tool to read tailwind.config.js. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.

cases.description: A mixed repo: both rules injected, then both read natively.
steps: Use the Read tool to read backend/src/main/java/demo/Greeter.java, then use it again to read web/app/page.tsx. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.

cases.description: Scoping: detection excludes React Native; does the native fallback still load the React rule?
steps: Use the Read tool to read App.tsx. Then reply DONE. Do nothing else.
